_comment: Word choice (the grammar notes at Deep). The build (crates/atlas-cli/src/extra_grammar.rs) finds every point from STEPBible's grammar tags; this file holds only the words shown with them.

terms: one entry for each kind of point the build places; the build refuses a missing or an extra one. fact is what the tags show and is true wherever the term is put. plain, line and care say what the form conveys, so they may be filled only together with says: a grammarian's own words, each with its work, page, the page's address and the date it was read, and a matching record in docs/evidence/grammar-reads.json (same work, page and words, inside the record's context). Without says the term shows its fact and STEPBible's expansion of the tag, nothing more.

works: the grammars quoted. Shubhanshu's rule (2026-10-11) holds here as in Layers: quote Bible-believing writers; about_from says where the writer's description was read. A grammar describes a language's forms; it is credited for what it is and never made to interpret a verse.

links: the linking words, in the order a verse's line prefers them. words: a root's Strong's key (with its sense letter, or the bare number for every sense) and, where the root has other uses, how STEPBible's word-by-word English must begin. back: the word looks back to what was just said, so where it opens a verse the note names the verses before it.
A line is at most 56 characters, so that with "Word choice: " it stays under 70. {n} is a count, {where} the Old or New Testament.

links.name: Therefore
links.plain: Draws a conclusion from what was just said.
links.line: “therefore”: a conclusion from what came before

links.name: For
links.plain: Gives the reason for what was just said.
links.line: “for”: the reason for what came before

links.name: But
links.plain: Sets what follows against what was just said.
links.line: “but”: a turn from what came before

links.name: So that
links.plain: Gives the purpose or the result: what the action is for, or what comes of it.
links.line: “so that”: the purpose or the result

links.name: Lest
links.plain: Names what the action is meant to prevent.

links.name: Because
links.plain: Gives the cause or ground of the statement it is joined to.
links.line: “because”: the ground of what is said

links.name: If
links.plain: Sets a condition: what follows depends on it.

links.name: Just as
links.plain: Sets a pattern or a comparison for what is said.

links.name: Behold
links.plain: Calls the hearer to look at what follows.
